description: This Java class 'ExternalIdFactory' provides methods to create and manipulate 'ExternalId' objects, including generating them from strings, lists, or command inputs, with configuration-based auto-generation support.

classes.name: ExternalIdFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating ExternalId instances based on input strings, command parameters, and configuration settings.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates an ExternalId object from a given string, returning an empty ExternalId if the string is blank.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates a list of ExternalId objects from a list of strings, mapping each string to an ExternalId.

methods.name: createFromCommand
methods.description: Creates an ExternalId from a JsonCommand object using a specified key, allowing null parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an ExternalId from a string; if blank, generates a new ExternalId based on configuration or returns an empty one.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an ExternalId with default null input, delegating to create(String).
